runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-21 doesn't set a fine for missing the AI strategy deadline. I found no penalty or fine for this in the passages I searched.

The memo does set the deadline itself. Within 180 days of the memo's issuance, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to responsible AI use and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of its applications. Agencies must use the AI Strategies template that OMB will provide, and they must make their strategies public.

The passages I retrieved don't describe any consequence for missing that deadline.
